Game Overview

Jeno the Big Eater is a arcade title where guide the ravenous Jeno through a vibrant 2D realm, devouring cupcakes while dodging perilous goblins and spikes. Master timing and double jumps across evolving challenges as you aim for the triumphant red flag. Embrace the colorful frenzy, where every level tests agility and strategy to satisfy Jeno’s sweet cravings.
